complete.note: Whether the run finished the whole tape.

feedforward.note: Which feed-forward terms the rung used, as the file words them.

improvement.note: factory tracking_rms divided by this rung's, same joint: how many times better than shipped gains. Factory is 1×.

joint.note: Joint name from the robot file; the five-bar lists only its two driven joints.

kd.note: Derivative gain as written in the result file.

kp.note: Proportional gain as written in the result file (its own units; not converted).

max_error.note: Worst absolute tracking error. Unit is the robot's (mrad or mm).

ringing.note: Oscillation after the stop. Unit is the robot's (mrad or mm).

robot.note: Demo robot (index.json title). Sim, illustrative parameters.

robot_id.note: pidtuna's robot key; joins to robots.json.

rung.note: Tuning method: factory (as-shipped gains), analytic (from the description), tuned (auto-tuner), oracle (tuned against the hidden truth).

rung_order.note: 0 factory, 1 analytic, 2 tuned, 3 oracle: sorts the ladder.

saturation.note: Fraction of samples at the torque limit, 0-1.

stop_p90.note: 90th percentile settling error at the stops. Unit is the robot's (mrad or mm); the score key says mrad even for mm robots.

tracking_rms.note: RMS tracking error over the benchmark tapes. Unit is the robot's (mrad or mm).
